name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two kettlebells at upper-chest height with your palms facing your shoulders and elbows tucked in front.
Brace your core and press both kettlebells upward while smoothly rotating your forearms outward so your palms face forward as your arms extend overhead.
Lock out gently overhead with your biceps close to your ears and ribs stacked over your hips.
Reverse the rotation as you lower both kettlebells with control back to the palms-in starting position.
tips: Keep your glutes and abs engaged so your lower back does not arch as the weights pass overhead.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows as your arms turn during the press.
